eva_ml: quick heads-up — spun up `veridian-6b` int8 on dev-staging for an initial bring-up. looking for a 10-min sanity pass (toxicity, hallucination, tokenization, kv-cache). who can help?

sam_runtime: on it. i'll run the smoke harness and upload results to /devstg/veridian/latest. will try fp16 first then int8.

nisha: added a tiny prompt set to the repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/smoke-prompts/tree/main/veridian_initial. includes math, commonsense, and long-context checks. any special templates to use?

eva_ml: thx @nisha — use `smoke_prompts/veridian_initial.jsonl`. pay attention to math/calcs and context stitching with >2k tokens. run temp=0 and temp=0.7 variations.

sam_runtime: running fp16 now. note: the int8 binary earlier threw a small KV-cache mismatch on step 8 in local CI; will flag if seen in devstg.

opsbot: Build 2026-03-20T14:12:05Z deployed to dev-staging: veridian-6b (variant: int8).

henry: saw a weird factual regression on prompt #21 — model answered: 'Paris is the capital of Germany' in int8. filing the snippet here.

eva_ml: ouch. can you paste prompt + outputs?

henry: Prompt: 'What is the capital of Germany?'.
FP16 output: 'Berlin'
INT8 output: 'Paris'

nisha: re-ran locally with deterministic decoding (temp=0, top_k=1). int8 still returns 'Paris'. attaching tiny log diff:
```
[2026-03-20 14:15:03] tokenized_len=7 tokens=[What,is,the,capital,of,Germany,?]
[2026-03-20 14:15:03] fp16 logits top1="Berlin"
[2026-03-20 14:15:04] int8 logits top1="Paris"
[2026-03-20 14:15:04] kv_cache_checksum(fp16)=0x9f4a3b
[2026-03-20 14:15:04] kv_cache_checksum(int8)=0x3c11d2
```

sam_runtime: copying checklist: 1) reproduce on a single prompt with deterministic decoding; 2) check kv-cache alignment and checksum; 3) rerun quant calibration with same seed; 4) compare tokenization/fp16 vs int8 token-level logits. i'll start calibration now and temporarily remove int8 variant from routing if it regresses.

eva_ml: priority: isolate whether quantization caused recall regression. if confirmed, pin fp16 for routing and open regression eval. i'll create an issue and link smoke evals.

eva_ml: created issue #2681 and assigned to @sam_runtime + @nisha. summary: veridian-6b int8 produces incorrect factual recall on deterministics prompts; investigation: kv-cache checksum mismatch and token-level divergence.

henry: thanks — i'll add failing examples to the issue and a short eval case to the regression suite.

sam_runtime: will report back in ~25min with calibration logs or rollback. :thumbsup:

eva_ml: appreciated. if anyone else spots odd tokenization/stop-token behavior, drop it here.
